scenes.title: Освобождение под условие  (Conditional Release)
scenes.summary: Viktor faces criminal charges at the police station for hitting Nagiyev with his car until Elena Pavlovna secures his release on condition that he work as her sous-chef.

scenes.title: Мастер-класс на складе  (Master Class in the Storage Room)
scenes.summary: Max teaches Denis how to peel potatoes in the storage room until Lyova catches them and announces a staff meeting with Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Новый шеф Герман  (New Chef German)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev returns from the hospital in a neck brace and introduces the polite, fit new head chef of Claude Monet, German Mikhailovich.

scenes.title: Две кухни на выбор  (Two Kitchens to Choose From)
scenes.summary: Viktor arrives an hour late at Arcobaleno and refuses to take orders from Elena until Police Colonel Sergey Konstantinovich reminds him of prison.

scenes.title: Кто будет стукачом  (Who Will Be the Informant)
scenes.summary: Fedya warns the cooks that German always recruits an informant in every kitchen, and Senya immediately offers his services to German.

scenes.title: Аттестация на кухне  (Kitchen Evaluation)
scenes.summary: Just as Lyova remarks how quiet the new head chef is, German steps out of his office and announces a surprise culinary evaluation.

scenes.title: Женская месть и старость  (A Woman's Revenge and Old Age)
scenes.summary: At Arcobaleno, Misha explains that Viktor needs Elena to let him go willingly, so Viktor pretends to be going senile while ironing his jacket.

scenes.title: Чашка кофе для шефа  (A Cup of Coffee for the Chef)
scenes.summary: Fedya teases Kostya for bringing coffee to German, prompting Kostya and Max to spit in the mug right before German invites Kostya to drink it.

scenes.title: Шинковка и забывчивость  (Knife Skills and Forgetfulness)
scenes.summary: While German tests the cooks at Claude Monet, Viktor pretends to forget ingredients and burn pans at Arcobaleno until Elena releases him.

scenes.title: Идеальный бешамель  (The Perfect Béchamel)
scenes.summary: Because Max swapped sauces with Denis, German praises Denis's béchamel as ideal, fires two weak cooks, and assigns Denis to cook Nagiyev's main course.

scenes.title: Дорада на спор  (Dorado on a Bet)
scenes.summary: Max discovers Denis chopped up the last dorado meant to be baked whole, while at Arcobaleno Elena tricks Viktor into a speed-cooking wager.

scenes.title: Разоблачение симулянта  (Exposing the Faker)
scenes.summary: Elena thanks Misha for helping expose Viktor's fake senility, deducts the ruined items from Viktor's pay, and sends Viktor out to serve a guest.

scenes.title: Знакомство с конкурентом  (Meeting the Rival)
scenes.summary: At Arcobaleno, Viktor meets the customer who ordered the dorado—German Mikhailovich—who jokes about Viktor running over Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Тайна отличника аттестации  (The Top Scorer's Secret)
scenes.summary: Max sneaks Viktor's cooked dorado into Claude Monet for German to serve Nagiyev, then confesses to the furious cooks that Denis is not a chef.

scenes.title: Знакомство с хозяином  (Meeting the Owner)
scenes.summary: Hoping to get fired from Arcobaleno without Elena's help, Viktor pours wine on the owner and his wife, but they mistake it for a bold joke.

scenes.title: Дорада с сюрпризом  (Dorado with a Surprise)
scenes.summary: German presents the flambéed dorado at Nagiyev's table while Viktor realizes at Arcobaleno that the fish stocked with firecrackers went to the wrong guest.

scenes.title: Фейерверк и наказание  (Fireworks and Punishment)
scenes.summary: The firecracker-stuffed dorado explodes in front of Nagiyev, German sentences Max to a month on vegetable prep, and Elena finally releases Viktor.

scenes.title: Благородный порыв  (A Noble Impulse)
scenes.summary: Timur reveals that Elena sold her own car to bribe the police colonel for Viktor's freedom, and Viktor returns to Arcobaleno as a regular cook to repay her.
